title: 그 삼십 초
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop R&B with a mid-tempo groove. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated, jazzy seventh chords with a light chorus effect. The bass guitar performs melodic, walking lines that emphasize the downbeat. Drums feature a crisp snare on the backbeat and a tight, dry kick drum pattern. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, breathy tenor with frequent use of falsetto and melismatic runs. Background vocals provide lush, multi-tracked harmonies and call-and-response adlibs. A subtle Rhodes piano adds harmonic depth with sustained chords in the background. Key of E Major, 95 BPM.
